name: Innistrad
description: Innistrad is a gothic plane where humanity is prey to werewolves, vampires, zombies, geists, demons and other horrors once the moon rises, and it is Sorin Markov's home plane.

summary.text: Innistrad is a gothic plane where humanity is prey to werewolves, vampires, zombies, geists, demons and other horrors once the moon rises, and it is Sorin Markov's home plane.

citations.text: "Innistrad". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: Sorin lorded over Innistrad for millennia, preserving the balance between humanity and the monsters that prey on it.

bio.text: When Avacyn, its protector, was lost, Tamiyo warned that the plane had lost its protector and the world shook, and madness swept the plane.

"Liliana's Indignation" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Apr 2016.

bio.text: Nahiri swore that Innistrad would bleed as Zendikar had, after which its final ward fell and she called Emrakul to the plane.

citations.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.
"Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.
"Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

bio.text: Nahiri then left the plane, with Sorin trapped, and Emrakul was bound and sealed in the moon of Innistrad.

timeline.summary: Sorin creates Avacyn and the Helvault and imprisons Nahiri inside it.
timeline.quote: Sorin Markov creates Avacyn and the Helvault .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana tracks Griselbrand to the Helvault and manipulates Thalia into destroying it.
timeline.quote: Liliana tracks Griselbrand 's disappearance to the Helvault and manipulates Thalia into destroying it.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri's spark ignites and she lands on Innistrad, where Sorin decides to mentor her.
timeline.quote: Instead of chasing the young and confused Planeswalker off the plane, Sorin decided to mentor Nahiri

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "The Three against the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri threatens Sorin after he admits her call for help was absorbed by the Helvault; he banishes her into it.
timeline.quote: Sorin called the battle off and banished Nahiri into the Helvault.

citation.text: "Sorin Markov", section "Imprisoning Nahiri". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn and her angels came to Innistrad and a new equilibrium was reached, driving back vampires, werewolves and the undead.
timeline.quote: But then Avacyn and her angels came, and with her presence a new equilibrium was reached.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Introduction
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Introduction". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Aug 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Demons and devils began to arrive in the opening left by the retreat of other monsters.
timeline.quote: The demons and their hosts of devils began to arrive, one by one.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Introduction
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Introduction". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Aug 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Avacyn fought and destroyed demons, who kept returning in new forms, so she decreed they be bound and adopted the silver collar as her symbol.
timeline.quote: Realizing this, Avacyn decreed that "What cannot be destroyed will be bound,"

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Introduction
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Introduction". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Aug 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Avacyn and Griselbrand disappeared around the same time.
timeline.quote: Griselbrand disappeared around the same time that Avacyn did

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Introduction
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Introduction". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Aug 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: With Avacyn missing, prayers and holy symbols fail to protect villages and the dead, and the Church's power wanes.
timeline.quote: But the archangel Avacyn has not been seen over the last few seasons, and her absence is beginning to tell.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Introduction
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Introduction". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Aug 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Liliana travels to Innistrad to hunt her three remaining demon masters.
timeline.quote: Which brings Liliana to Innistrad.

citation.text: "Liliana's Mission". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Aug 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The column reveals that Griselbrand is one of Liliana's demon masters and has gone missing.
timeline.quote: currently a missing person, having disappeared around the same time that the archangel Avacyn

citation.text: "Liliana's Mission". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Aug 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Some of Innistrad's humans refuse to be victims and become slayers and cathars, and a few take all of humanity as their responsibility as guardians.
timeline.quote: Some become cathars, holy warriors who train to destroy the fiends that prey upon humanity.

citation.text: "Champion of the Parish". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Sep 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The champion emerges in a parish by taking personal responsibility for striking a blow for humanity, sanctioned only by the support of a desperate people.
timeline.quote: It is a position given sanction by the support of a desperate people in a time of need.

citation.text: "Champion of the Parish". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Sep 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Avacyn's faith, humanity's former secret weapon, loses potency night after night as monsters hold every advantage.
timeline.quote: The monsters have all the advantages and humanity's former secret weapon—the power of faith in the archangel Avacyn—is losing its potency night after night.

citation.text: "Champion of the Parish". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Sep 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Avacyn has abandoned humanity, yet champions still resolve to stand between the lurking dangers and their fellow humans.
timeline.quote: But they know they must try, and that gives them a kind of heroism no matter how the story ends.

citation.text: "Champion of the Parish". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Sep 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The chapel is dragged under and its bell rings until silenced.
timeline.quote: As the chapel was dragged under, the bell in the tower rang until the murky depths forever silenced its toll.

citation.text: Maw of the Mire (Innistrad, 2011), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Griselbrand stands against Avacyn and earns loathing and admiration.
timeline.quote: The demon Griselbrand dared to stand against Avacyn, earning him the loathing of thousands and the admiration of a few.

citation.text: Disciple of Griselbrand (Innistrad, 2011), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Grizzled hunters vanish one night and their boot prints become paw prints.
timeline.quote: The boot prints became paw prints, and they led right back into town.

citation.text: Krallenhorde Wantons (Innistrad, 2011), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sorin creates the archangel Avacyn to maintain equilibrium between humans and monsters on Innistrad.
timeline.quote: Sorin Markov created the archangel Avacyn to maintain an equilibrium between humans and the monsters that preyed on them

citation.text: "Angel", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin Markov creates Avacyn and tasks her with protecting Innistrad.
timeline.quote: The vampire planeswalker Sorin Markov created Avacyn and tasked her with protecting Innistrad.

citation.text: "Avacyn", section "The Creation of Avacyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn has not been seen for several seasons and darkness advances.
timeline.quote: However, the Archangel Avacyn had not been seen in several seasons

citation.text: "Church of Avacyn", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana forces Thalia to destroy the Helvault, freeing Avacyn.
timeline.quote: She forced the cathar Thalia to destroy the silver Helvault , where Avacyn was held, to reach one of her enemies .

citation.text: "Church of Avacyn", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn and her angels become corrupted and turn on humanity.
timeline.quote: Convinced of the evil of humanity, they turned on those they had sworn to protect

citation.text: "Church of Avacyn", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn is destroyed beneath one of her churches to prevent further extermination of mankind.
timeline.quote: Her crusades blazed a bloody path across this world until she was destroyed beneath one of her churches

citation.text: "Church of Avacyn", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lunarch Mikaeus dies in the Siege of Thraben and his successor Macher is killed early in Avacyn's madness.
timeline.quote: After Lunarch Mikaeus died during the Siege of Thraben , and his successor Macher was killed in the early days of Avacyn's madness

citation.text: "Church of Avacyn", section "Lunarch Council". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dack goes to Innistrad and makes enemies of the Falkenrath vampires.
timeline.quote: He wasted no time in blundering directly into the vampires of the world, gaining the enmity of the Falkenrath in the process.

citation.text: "Dack Fayden", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dack and Ingrid confront Sifa as she gathers a town; Dack drives her off but loses her.
timeline.quote: Dack drove Sifa and her minions away, but he lost her before he could exact his revenge.

citation.text: "Dack Fayden", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin Markov freezes the Cathars in stasis and trades knowledge of Sifa for the dagger and their lives.
timeline.quote: He traded knowledge of Sifa for the dagger and the lives of the Cathars.

citation.text: "Dack Fayden", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: IDW's comic series, tied to the Innistrad storyline, introduces the planeswalker Dack Fayden.
timeline.quote: It introduced a new planeswalker, Dack Fayden , who was involved in the Innistrad storyline.

citation.text: "Dengeki-Maoh", section "IDW comics". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Garruk tracks Liliana to Innistrad but her ghouls let her escape, and the curse overtakes him.
timeline.quote: He crossed her path once in Nephalia , but was beset by her ghouls.

citation.text: "Garruk", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn's Cursemute dulls the Chain Veil's influence and temporarily frees Garruk, who chooses to keep tracking Liliana.
timeline.quote: the curse was pushed into remission, temporarily freeing Garruk

citation.text: "Garruk", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Odric traps and drugs Garruk to take him to trial before Avacyn, but Garruk escapes enraged.
timeline.quote: Garruk became enraged and escaped Odric and his Riders.

citation.text: "Garruk", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Geralf sends skaabs to free Gisa, then busies himself with his masterpiece under Ludevic.
timeline.quote: Geralf sent a horde of skaabs to set his sister free, although she stated afterward that she didn't need his help.

citation.text: "Geralf Cecani", section "Aftermath of the siege". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana causes the sundering of the Helvault.
timeline.quote: Shortly afterwards, Liliana caused the sundering of the Helvault .

citation.text: "Gisa Cecani", section "NecroWarfare". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Geralf sends skaabs to free Gisa, who says she did not need his help; she retreats to her parents' manor and revives them as zombies.
timeline.quote: Geralf sent a horde of skaabs to set his sister free, although she stated afterward that she didn't need his help.

citation.text: "Gisa Cecani", section "Aftermath of the siege". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Edgar Markov inflicted vampirism on his grandson Sorin, awakening Sorin's planeswalker spark.
timeline.quote: Edgar inflicted his curse of vampirism on his grandson Sorin, awakening Sorin's latent planeswalker's spark .

citation.text: "Helvault", section "Birth of vampirism". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn defeated demons one by one and forged the Silver Collar to bind demonkind.
timeline.quote: She then forged a collar of silver to bind demonkind

citation.text: "Helvault", section "Demons and Devilry". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn and her angels drew malevolent beings, including Nahiri, into the Helvault.
timeline.quote: the Helvault also contained Nahiri

citation.text: "Helvault", section "The Helvault imprisonment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Griselbrand landed on the Helvault under a full moon and challenged Avacyn.
timeline.quote: he landed on the Helvault itself, under a full moon, and challenged Avacyn to combat.

citation.text: "Helvault", section "The Helvault imprisonment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After days of battle Avacyn drove Griselbrand into the Helvault; he impaled her heart with his spear and she was drawn in too.
timeline.quote: Avacyn was drawn into the Helvault herself.

citation.text: "Helvault", section "The Helvault imprisonment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Innistrad hedonistic vampires stalk the shadows, and the full moon can transform a villager into a werewolf.
timeline.quote: hedonistic vampires stalk the shadows to quench their thirst, and the full moon can transform a simple villager into a savage werewolf

citation.text: "Innistrad", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana Vess and Garruk Wildspeaker return as the new cards Liliana of the Veil and Garruk Relentless.
timeline.quote: Liliana Vess returned as a new card named Liliana of the Veil .

citation.text: "Innistrad", section "Themes and mechanics". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Edgar Markov, urged by the demon Shilgengar, traps and exsanguinates the angel Marycz and creates the ritual of vampirism.
timeline.quote: Markov and his sons trapped the angel Marycz in his laboratory and exsanguinated her

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "Birth of Vampirism". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Edgar forces his grandson Sorin to turn, igniting Sorin's planeswalker spark.
timeline.quote: the trauma of the transformation caused the boy's planeswalker spark to ignite

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "Birth of Vampirism". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin forges the angel Avacyn to protect humanity from the vampires, along with the Helvault, and is reviled as a traitor by most vampires.
timeline.quote: Sorin forged a warrior who could hold back the vampires and other threats

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "Creation of Avacyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Nahiri confronts him over the lost Zendikar signal, Sorin banishes her into the Helvault following a clash with Avacyn.
timeline.quote: Sorin called the battle off and banished Nahiri into the Helvault.

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "Imprisoning Nahiri". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Thraben Militia, an angry mob, hunts a monster after it has killed and been spotted by a Thraben Sentry.
timeline.quote: The card is an angry mob on the hunt for a monster after it has killed, and been spotted by Thraben Sentry

citation.text: "Innistrad/Trivia", section "Transformation cards". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Garruk slays Liliana's undead swarm in Nephalia, letting her escape.
timeline.quote: He slew all of the undead, but it was enough to allow Liliana to escape.

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Thalia chooses to save her men, causing the Sundering of the Helvault.
timeline.quote: Thalia chose to save her men, allowing the Sundering of the Helvault to take place.

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana kills Griselbrand with the Chain Veil.
timeline.quote: used the Chain Veil to kill Griselbrand once and for all before leaving Innistrad

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mikaeus witnesses the duel of Avacyn and Griselbrand and their imprisonment, swearing the witnesses to secrecy.
timeline.quote: those present (including the Lunarch himself) chose to swear themselves to secrecy

citation.text: "Mikaeus Cecani", section "Imprisonment of Avacyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri confronts Sorin on Innistrad, threatens him, fights Avacyn and is imprisoned by Sorin in the Helvault.
timeline.quote: The two fought until Sorin ended the battle by imprisoning Nahiri in the Helvault.

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "Imprisoned on Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Olivia drinks the angel Marycz's blood in Shilgengar's Ritual and becomes an immortal vampire.
timeline.quote: This turned her into an immortal vampire .

citation.text: "Olivia Voldaren", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At 16, Sorin is forced to drink the blood of the archangel Marycz in Shilgengar's Ritual, igniting his spark.
timeline.quote: The trauma of the transformation and the situation caused Sorin's planeswalker spark to ignite.

citation.text: "Sorin Markov", section "Vampiric Ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin forges Avacyn to protect humanity from vampires, earning the title of traitor to his race.
timeline.quote: He named this creation Avacyn and tasked the angel with protecting the plane in his absence.

citation.text: "Sorin Markov", section "Avacyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin trades Dack Fayden his life for the Ancient Fang and points him to Grixis.
timeline.quote: In exchange for the Ancient Fang , Sorin let Dack and his friends live.

citation.text: "Sorin Markov", section "The Ancient Fang". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn ushers spirits into the aether until her absence and madness leaves many clinging to the world of the living.
timeline.quote: In her absence—and later her madness—many spirits cling to the world of the living

citation.text: "Spirit", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: When Emrakul is summoned, benevolent geists bond with cathars, forming the Order of Saint Traft.
timeline.quote: the Order of Saint Traft was formed from this union.

citation.text: "Spirit", section "Varieties and factions". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Innistrad Tamiyo studies the silver moon and Avacyn's release from the Helvault.
timeline.quote: Tamiyo excitedly began writing theories about the angel 's influence on the land, its creatures, and the moon.

citation.text: "Tamiyo", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tibalt decides to interfere with Sorin Markov on Innistrad to torment him.
timeline.quote: Tibalt decided that he had to interfere

citation.text: "Tibalt", section "Tibalt vs. Sorin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Edgar Markov undergoes a blood ritual during a famine, giving birth to vampires on Innistrad.
timeline.quote: Thus were vampires born on Innistrad.

citation.text: "Vampire", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With Avacyn absent, the dead are more easily stirred and benevolent geists appear alongside malevolent ones.
timeline.quote: In Avacyn's absence, the malevolent spirits were counterbalanced by the appearance of many benevolent and neutral geists

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Nephalia and the Undead
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Nephalia and the Undead". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Nadia recalls her family's deaths: her father to a werewolf, her mother to a vampire.
timeline.quote: Her father had died to a werewolf in the field near their house.

citation.text: "Deathtrap". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Vampires follow the ritual of siring: a vampire introduces its blood to a victim, who must drink the sire's blood before the next new moon or die.
timeline.quote: A newly anointed victim who doesn't drink the sire's blood before the next new moon will die.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Stensia and Vampires
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Stensia and Vampires". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Nov 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Avacyn disappears, weakening the holy symbols' power over vampires.
timeline.quote: although their ability to do so has significantly diminished in the last year (because of Avacyn's disappearance).

citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Stensia and Vampires". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Nov 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.quote: the sound of Innistrad should be a blend of Prussian with dashes of Old Germanic, Dutch, and French.

citation.text: "Phonemes: The Molecules of Flavor". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Dec 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The plane finally gets the name Innistrad, replacing placeholder names.
timeline.quote: "Yes! This is Innistrad. Now I can really get writing about it."

citation.text: "Phonemes: The Molecules of Flavor". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Dec 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Krallenhorde is named as a Germanic werewolf horde.
timeline.quote: Thus was born "The Krallenhorde."

citation.text: "Phonemes: The Molecules of Flavor". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Dec 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Avacyn disappears; the wards weaken and the Church recruits new holy warriors.
timeline.quote: Even after Avacyn disappeared and the fiendish creatures of the night advanced, the people of the four provinces survived.

citation.work: A Backstory Update for Dark Ascension
citation.text: "A Backstory Update for Dark Ascension". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jan 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.quote: Apparently slain werewolves have begun to stagger back to their feet

citation.text: "A Backstory Update for Dark Ascension". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jan 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.quote: Demonic cults have gained in membership as people seek some power, any power, on which they can rely.

citation.text: "A Backstory Update for Dark Ascension". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jan 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.quote: She has found that the demon Griselbrand is here, on Innistrad

citation.text: "A Backstory Update for Dark Ascension". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jan 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.quote: has tracked the death-witch to Innistrad.
