citation.text: "A Backstory Update for Dark Ascension". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jan 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sorin sees vampires dwindling the human villages and creates the angel Avacyn to protect Innistrad, giving rise to the Church of Avacyn.
timeline.quote: He created an angel he named Avacyn and tasked her with protecting the plane.

citation.text: "Sorin's Homecoming". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Jan 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Avacyn disappears from Innistrad, upsetting the balance between humans and monsters.
timeline.quote: But now Avacyn has disappeared from Innistrad.

citation.text: "Sorin's Homecoming". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Jan 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sorin returns to Innistrad to find vampires killing at will, werewolves preying on cathars, and ghouls besieging Thraben, and draws his sword.
timeline.quote: the ancient vampire draws his sword under the light of a grim moon.

citation.text: "Sorin's Homecoming". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Jan 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Edgar Markov, prodded by the demon Shilgengar, creates vampirism on Innistrad and inflicts it on his grandson Sorin, awakening Sorin's planeswalker spark.
timeline.quote: Edgar inflicted his curse of vampirism on his grandson, Sorin, awakening Sorin's latent planeswalker spark.

citation.text: "The Prison of Silver". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sorin returns to Innistrad after centuries and creates the archangel Avacyn to safeguard humanity.
timeline.quote: He created the archangel Avacyn to safeguard humanity

citation.text: "The Prison of Silver". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Avacyn and her angels slaughter vampires, werewolves, geists and ghouls; Sorin's kin brand him a traitor.
timeline.quote: They slew vampires with holy fervor, prompting Sorin's kin to brand him a traitor to their kind.

citation.text: "The Prison of Silver". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: With the monsters in retreat, demons and devils manifest in greater numbers; Avacyn defeats them one by one and forges the Silver Collar to bind them.
timeline.quote: She then forged a collar of silver to bind demonkind

citation.text: "The Prison of Silver". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: With Avacyn gone, holy wards fail, her angels dwindle and evil creatures grow bolder, causing a crisis of faith across Innistrad.
timeline.quote: Holy wards failed and prayers to Avacyn went unanswered.

citation.text: "The Prison of Silver". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Griselbrand turns the Helvault against Avacyn, trapping her inside and leaving Innistrad without a protector.
timeline.quote: The demon Griselbrand challenged Avacyn and turned the tables at the last moment

citation.text: "The State of the Faith". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Avacyn is forced into the Helvault, leaving her flights of angels unable to protect Innistrad as before.
timeline.quote: Back before Avacyn was forced into the Helvault

citation.text: "Inboxing Day: Dark Ascension". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Feb 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Without Avacyn the angels suffer wounds and must retreat and bide their time against Innistrad's shadowy creatures.
timeline.quote: They suffer wounds and have to retreat.

citation.text: "Inboxing Day: Dark Ascension". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Feb 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Liliana Vess boasts that she can create more than Innistrad's ghoulcallers.
timeline.quote: let me show you what someone with real power can create.

citation.text: Gravecrawler (Dark Ascension, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Garruk Wildspeaker confronts Liliana Vess, vowing she cannot hide on the dark plane.
timeline.quote: I have taken down countless night hunters and this dark plane is not big enough for you to hide.

citation.text: Crushing Vines (Dark Ascension, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sorin Markov laments that only the shadow of his creation, the archangel, remains.
timeline.quote: Now only her shadow remains.

citation.text: Vault of the Archangel (Dark Ascension, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Liesa allies with a demon lord and Avacyn destroys the entire Flight of Dusk.
timeline.quote: earning the condemnation of her sisters and Avacyn, who declared her a heretic and destroyed the entire flight

citation.text: "Angel", section "The Flight of Dusk". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Isobel, driven mad, joins Avacyn's rampage and is slain by the humans she once protected.
timeline.quote: Later driven to madness, Isobel joined Avacyn's rampage against the people of Innistrad and was consequently slain by the humans she once protected.

citation.text: "Church of Avacyn", section "Avacyn's Host". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn executes Liesa for making a pact with a demon and destroys the Flight of Dusk.
timeline.quote: when she betrayed the angels by making a pact with a demon, an enraged Avacyn executed Liesa and destroyed the entire flight

citation.text: "Church of Avacyn", section "Avacyn's Host". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After her descent into madness, Avacyn forms the Flight of Moonsilver.
timeline.quote: After Avacyn's descent into madness, she formed the Flight of Moonsilver

citation.text: "Church of Avacyn", section "Avacyn's Host". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Order of Saint Traft forms shortly before the Battle of Thraben.
timeline.quote: The Order of Saint Traft came into being during the last part of the Travails , shortly before the Battle of Thraben .

citation.text: "Church of Avacyn", section "Order of Saint Traft". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Innistrad is overrun by creatures of the night while humans near extinction; Avacyn is revealed to be locked in the Helvault.
timeline.quote: It is revealed that Avacyn , the guardian angel created by Sorin is locked in the Helvault .

citation.text: "Dark Ascension", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana causes the Sundering of the Helvault, freeing Avacyn, who casts the Cursemute and creates the Wolfir.
timeline.quote: Liliana caused the Sundering of the Helvault , and Avacyn was free.

citation.text: "Thraben", section "Siege of Thraben". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Devils swarm out of the crevices of Innistrad as Dark Ascension sweeps the plane.
timeline.quote: devils swarm out of the crevices of the plane, their shrill laughter heard in every village

citation.text: "Sympathy for the Devils". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Priests and cathars kill devils on sight, knowing they herald ruin.
timeline.quote: Priests and cathars have taken to killing them on sight whenever possible

citation.text: "Sympathy for the Devils". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The column describes Innistrad's night creatures coming back stronger after being killed, making monsters more fearsome to the humans of the world.
timeline.quote: The night-lurking creatures of Innistrad not only survive the heroes' best efforts to kill them, but come back stronger than ever.

citation.work: The Horror of Breaking the Rules
citation.text: "The Horror of Breaking the Rules". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Feb 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Garruk, afflicted by Liliana's curse, pursues her across Innistrad.
timeline.quote: Even as she is on Griselbrand's trail, Garruk is on hers

citation.work: The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel
citation.text: "The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Liliana doubts the Chain Veil even as she needs it against Garruk.
timeline.quote: she is beginning to feel doubts about the wisdom of using the Chain Veil to further her death magic

citation.work: The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel
citation.text: "The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: A golden helix streaked from the Helvault, which exploded, and Avacyn emerged free from her prison.
timeline.quote: Avacyn emerged, free from her prison at last.

citation.text: Avacyn, Angel of Hope (Avacyn Restored, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Thalia states that Avacyn's freedom came at the price of Griselbrand.
timeline.quote: Avacyn emerged from the broken Helvault, but her freedom came at a price

citation.text: Griselbrand (Avacyn Restored, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Avacyn cleansed the world with divine fire in a wave of spells called the Cursemute.
timeline.quote: In a wave of spells called the Cursemute, Avacyn cleansed the world with divine fire.

citation.text: Reforge the Soul (Avacyn Restored, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Avacyn decreed werewolves to become the wolfir, allies against darkness.
timeline.quote: werewolves shall become the wolfir, our allies in combat against darkness.

citation.text: Joint Assault (Avacyn Restored, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Helvault was destroyed and fearful mobs became fearless battalions.
timeline.quote: After the destruction of the Helvault, fearful mobs soon became fearless battalions.

citation.text: Banners Raised (Avacyn Restored, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Liliana Vess arrives seeking demons and finds a plane of angels.
timeline.quote: I come looking for demons and I find a plane full of angels.

citation.text: Killing Wave (Avacyn Restored, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Corrupted by Emrakul, Avacyn goes mad and the new Flight of Moonsilver aids her genocidal rampage against humanity.
timeline.quote: aiding her in her genocidal rampage against humanity

citation.text: "Angel", section "The Flight of Moonsilver". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana Vess forces Thalia to open the Helvault, releasing the demons and Avacyn.
timeline.quote: This resulted in the release of both the demons and Avacyn

citation.text: "Avacyn", section "Return". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rescuing Maeli, Avacyn is hit by a strange spell that fills her with disgust toward humans.
timeline.quote: This event, combined with foreign thoughts, caused Avacyn to feel a new sense of disgust toward humans.

citation.text: "Avacyn", section "Corruption and death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn's madness is revealed to be caused by Nahiri's cryptoliths summoning Emrakul.
timeline.quote: Avacyn's madness was caused by Nahiri's cryptoliths summoning Emrakul to the plane

citation.text: "Avacyn", section "Corruption and death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn verbally abuses Lunarch Macher and kills the werewolf Liont after his prayer.
timeline.quote: Avacyn responded to the prayer by breaking through the roof of Liont's house and killing him

citation.text: "Avacyn", section "Corruption and death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn visits Sigarda with Bruna and Gisela, advocating a genocidal solution and threatening Sigarda.
timeline.quote: Avacyn blew up Sigarda's roof and implied a threat towards her should she not collaborate

citation.text: "Avacyn", section "Corruption and death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn leads angels to slaughter Kelse's village and burns Kelse.
timeline.quote: slaughtering its inhabitants with beams of light and prompting a crisis of faith in Kelse

citation.text: "Avacyn", section "Corruption and death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A thousand years earlier Avacyn slew Liesa and her angel flight for allying with a demon lord.
timeline.quote: Avacyn single-handedly slew Liesa and her entire angel flight for their heresy

citation.text: "Avacyn", section "Psychology". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn, Griselbrand and numerous other demons are released from the Helvault.
timeline.quote: has been released from her prisoning, the Helvault .

citation.text: "Avacyn Restored", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn campaigns to rally her troops to contain the demonic threat and cleanse Innistrad of the infernal creatures.
timeline.quote: Avacyn Restored shows Avacyn's campaign to rally her troops to contain the demonic threat and, ultimately, to cleanse Innistrad of all these infernal creatures.

citation.text: "Avacyn Restored", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Innistrad Liliana fails to exorcise the Veil's spirits, but harms Emrakul with the Veil's power.
timeline.quote: She failed.

citation.text: "Chain Veil", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin created the archangel Avacyn to safeguard humanity.
timeline.quote: He created the archangel Avacyn to safeguard humanity

citation.text: "Helvault", section "Creation of Avacyn and the Helvault". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin fashioned the Helvault from a chunk of the silver moon using lithomancy learned from Nahiri.
timeline.quote: Sorin fashioned it from a chunk of the plane's silver moon .

citation.text: "Helvault", section "Creation of Avacyn and the Helvault". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn's imprisonment caused a crisis of faith across Innistrad.
timeline.quote: leading to a crisis of faith across all four provinces

citation.text: "Helvault", section "The waning of the light". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana Vess threatened Thalia, leading to the sundering of the Helvault and the release of Avacyn and the demons.
timeline.quote: With the sundering of the Helvault , both Avacyn and the demons were unleashed back into the world.

citation.text: "Helvault", section "Destruction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Griselbrand fights Avacyn for days; she drives him into the Helvault but is impaled by his spear and trapped inside alongside the demons.
timeline.quote: Avacyn became imprisoned in the Helvault alongside every other demon that had been trapped within

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "Disappearance of balance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn transforms the Gatstaf werewolves into wolfir and her cursemute spreads through the plane.
timeline.quote: she transformed them into the wolfir

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "The Cursemute". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Freed from the Helvault, Nahiri finds Zendikar ravaged, swears vengeance on Sorin and destroys Markov Manor.
timeline.quote: She attacked Markov Manor , destroying it with lithomancy

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "The Travails". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri's cryptoliths, powered by Innistrad's leylines, summon Emrakul and drive many angels, including Avacyn, mad.
timeline.quote: These cryptholiths also caused multiple angels

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "The Travails". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn abandons humanity and becomes the advocate of their genocide, and the cursemute breaks.
timeline.quote: caused Avacyn to abandon humanity and become the advocate of their genocide

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "The Travails". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin finds Markov Manor in ruins and seeks help from Olivia Voldaren.
timeline.quote: His search brought him to the remote estate of the powerful Olivia Voldaren

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "The Travails". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri destroys Markov Manor, builds cryptoliths and the Drownyard Temple, and summons Emrakul to Innistrad.
timeline.quote: She attacked Markov Manor , destroying it with lithomancy

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "Revenge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn, fully corrupted, confronts Sigarda and threatens her; Sigarda vows to fight the archangel.
timeline.quote: Sigarda cried and vowed to fight the archangel.

citation.text: "Sigarda", section "Survivor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin creates the Helvault so Avacyn can seal away threats; she battles demons such as Ormendahl for about a thousand years.
timeline.quote: and sealing them within the Helvault

citation.text: "Sundering of the Helvault", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hundreds of years earlier, Nahiri seeks Sorin's aid; provoked, he has Avacyn imprison her in the Helvault.
timeline.quote: the resulting confrontation led to Nahiri’s imprisonment within the vault

citation.text: "Sundering of the Helvault", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In 4557 AR Griselbrand tricks Avacyn into banishing him into the Helvault and pulls her in, sealing them both.
timeline.quote: sealing them both inside

citation.text: "Sundering of the Helvault", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn returns and leads a renewed crusade of angels; holy magic is restored.
timeline.quote: Avacyn returned to the world, leading a renewed crusade of angels to protect humanity.

citation.text: "Sundering of the Helvault", section "Consequences". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana uses the Chain Veil to obliterate Griselbrand permanently.
timeline.quote: Liliana used the Chain Veil to obliterate him permanently

citation.text: "Sundering of the Helvault", section "Consequences". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Voluptara Highwater is freed from the Helvault.
timeline.quote: Voluptara Highwater was another demon who was freed from the Helvault upon its destruction.

citation.text: "Sundering of the Helvault", section "Consequences". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Avacyn's return the Mondronen howlpack is dissolved.
timeline.quote: After the return of Avacyn, the howlpack was dissolved.

citation.text: "Werewolf", section "The Mondronen howlpack". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn offers repentant werewolves a place at her side and transforms them into the wolfir.
timeline.quote: Avacyn offered repentant humans afflicted by the lycanthropic curse a special place at her side

citation.text: "Werewolf", section "Wolfir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The transformation is mostly reversed when Avacyn is corrupted through Nahiri's machinations.
timeline.quote: The transformation was mostly reversed when Avacyn was corrupted through the machinations of Nahiri

citation.text: "Werewolf", section "Wolfir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After being released from the Helvault, Avacyn casts the cursemute, letting werewolves choose to fuse their human and wolf spirits into a permanent wolf form.
timeline.quote: After Avacyn was released from the Helvault , she cast a spell that granted the werewolves a choice to either remain a werewolf

citation.text: "Wolf", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The cursemute also stifles Garruk's curse for a while.
timeline.quote: This spell is called the cursemute , and also stifled Garruk 's curse for a while.

citation.text: "Wolf", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The journal reveals vampires were created by humans: Markov and the demon Shilgengar used an angel's blood, after trapping and draining Marycz.
timeline.quote: Markov and his sons trapped the angel Marycz in his laboratory and exsanguinated her

citation.text: "The Lunarch's Journal" by Colin Kawakami. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: The journal says Sorin created Avacyn to hold the vampires in check and that the church keeps humans as livestock, never able to defeat them; Dovid concludes his faith is a lie.
timeline.quote: We are livestock. We are unwitting participants in our own cultivation.

citation.text: "The Lunarch's Journal" by Colin Kawakami. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Liliana honed necromancy on Innistrad on undead and sometimes the living.
timeline.quote: On Innistrad, Liliana embraced necromancy, honing her powers by practicing on scores of undead—and sometimes the living.

citation.text: Cruel Revival (Magic Origins, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Liliana's spark ignites and she arrives on Innistrad.
timeline.quote: At that moment, she unlocked her Planeswalker's spark and ended up on Innistrad .

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin Markov crushes Liliana in a duel.
timeline.quote: They dueled, and Sorin crushed her and pronounced her too weak to be a threat.

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Nissa releases the Titans, Emrakul vanishes and is drawn to Innistrad by Nahiri, who wants revenge on Sorin.
timeline.quote: She was drawn through the Blind Eternities to the plane of Innistrad by the planeswalker Nahiri

citation.text: "Emrakul", section "The Eldrazi released". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn holds Emrakul at bay until Sorin unmakes her, and then Emrakul enters Innistrad physically.
timeline.quote: once she was unmade by Sorin, the titan physically entered Innistrad

citation.text: "Emrakul", section "The Eldrazi released". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Emrakul possesses Tamiyo and forces her to read a scroll, voluntarily trapping herself in Innistrad's moon.
timeline.quote: She possessed Tamiyo and forced her to read a scroll she had vowed to never read, voluntarily trapping herself in Innistrad's moon .

citation.text: "Emrakul", section "The Eldrazi released". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin unmakes Avacyn after Emrakul's corruption.
timeline.quote: Emrakul's corruption forces Sorin to unmake Avacyn.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Gatewatch Period". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana formally joins the Gatewatch after the Battle of Thraben.
timeline.quote: Liliana formally joins the Gatewatch.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Gatewatch Period". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sigarda recalls how, a thousand years ago, Avacyn destroyed their heretic sister and her entire flight after the sister allied with a demon lord.
timeline.quote: Avacyn single-handedly destroyed their sister and her entire small flight

citation.text: "A Gaze Blank and Pitiless" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana recalls her one meeting with Sorin long ago, when he tested and dismissed her and warned her to be a civil guest (recounted).
timeline.quote: He sought me out, tested my strength in battle, and pronounced me too weak to be a threat.

citation.text: "Unwelcome" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Journal entry 433: the author dissects a large werewolf specimen sent by Jenrik.
timeline.quote: With great effort, the rib cage was separated, the specimen split from clavicle to pelvis, its contents exposed to air.

citation.text: "The Drownyard Temple" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: The author finds the specimen's interior filled with sinew and almost nothing human, with a large cluster growing on the liver.
timeline.quote: This one, though. This one was...new.

citation.text: "The Drownyard Temple" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin must end Avacyn, whom he created.
timeline.quote: Sorin had created Avacyn, so it was a cruelty beyond imagining, a pain beyond description, that it fell upon him to end her forever.

citation.text: Anguished Unmaking (Shadows over Innistrad Promos, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ormendahl quickly takes Griselbrand's place for the Skirsdag.
timeline.quote: Ormendahl did not make them wait long.

citation.text: Ormendahl, Profane Prince (Shadows over Innistrad Promos, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Nahiri vows to take everything from Sorin.
timeline.quote: Sorin, I'm going to take everything from you.

citation.text: Nahiri's Machinations (Shadows over Innistrad, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Nahiri compares Zendikar's bleeding to what Innistrad and Sorin will suffer.
timeline.quote: As Zendikar has bled, so will Innistrad. As I have wept, so will Sorin.

citation.text: Structural Distortion (Shadows over Innistrad, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Nahiri twists stone gargoyles to her will.
timeline.quote: Nahiri twisted them in shape and bent them to her will.

citation.text: Stonewing Antagonizer (Shadows over Innistrad, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The howling of werewolves marks the end of the Cursemute and the start of Avacyn's madness.
timeline.quote: The renewed howling of werewolves announced the end of the Cursemute—and the beginning of Avacyn's madness.

citation.text: Howlpack Resurgence (Shadows over Innistrad, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Thalia founds the Order of Saint Traft against the Lunarch Council's corruption.
timeline.quote: Thalia established the Order of Saint Traft in an effort to bring together cathars who would stand against the corruption of the Lunarch Council.

citation.text: Tenacity (Shadows over Innistrad, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Cathars of the Order of Saint Traft turn on each other.
timeline.quote: Cathars who had fought shoulder to shoulder were at each other's throats.

citation.text: Dissension in the Ranks (Shadows over Innistrad, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Jace confronts Liliana with accusations after she was asked for help.
timeline.quote: Days ago, you came to my door asking for help, Jace. Yet now here you are with accusations?

citation.text: Liliana's Indignation (Shadows over Innistrad, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Liliana is angered by Nahiri's provocation.
timeline.quote: You sought to anger me, Nahiri. Soon you will see how well you have succeeded.

citation.text: Merciless Resolve (Shadows over Innistrad, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Skirsdag infiltrate the Lunarch Council.
timeline.quote: Having infiltrated the Lunarch Council, the Skirsdag await the perfect moment to strike.

citation.text: Spiteful Motives (Shadows over Innistrad, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ludevic proposes collaboration to Geralf.
timeline.quote: At your convenience, I would be honored to collaborate on a project.

citation.text: Seagraf Skaab (Shadows over Innistrad, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gisa mocks her brother Geralf for sharing his toys with Ludevic.
timeline.quote: Dear brother, it's sweet that you have chosen to share your toys with Ludevic, but I too have found some new playmates.

citation.text: Rise from the Tides (Shadows over Innistrad, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Nahiri's machinations drive Avacyn and most angels insane, fragmenting the Church.
timeline.quote: Due to Nahiri 's machinations, Avacyn and most other angels became insane and began killing the people of Innistrad.

citation.text: "Church of Avacyn", section "Lunarch Inquisition". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri summons Emrakul to Innistrad to take revenge on Sorin; Avacyn and the angels go mad, and Emrakul corrupts inhabitants.
timeline.quote: She was summoned to Innistrad by Nahiri to take revenge on Sorin, and her presence drove Avacyn and the angels to madness.

citation.text: "Eldrazi", section "Shadows over Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Emrakul allows herself to be imprisoned in Innistrad's moon.
timeline.quote: Emrakul allowed herself to be imprisoned in Innistrad's moon for an unknown purpose.

citation.text: "Eldrazi", section "Shadows over Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Innistrad, Emrakul's influence causes madness; Jace brings the Gatewatch back, Liliana arrives with a zombie army, and Nissa is nearly killed by the Chain Veil's power.
timeline.quote: On Innistrad, Jace found only madness that affected the entire plane

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Emrakul is sealed in Innistrad's moon, and Liliana decides to join the Gatewatch to direct it.
timeline.quote: Emrakul had been sealed in Innistrad's moon by the Gatewatch and Tamiyo

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Geralf and Gisa briefly set aside their differences to join Liliana against the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: Gisa and Geralf briefly managed to put their differences aside to join her and team up against the Eldrazi.

citation.text: "Geralf Cecani", section "Shadows over Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gisa and Geralf briefly team up against the Eldrazi that invaded Innistrad.
timeline.quote: Gisa and Geralf briefly managed to put their differences aside to team up against the Eldrazi.

citation.text: "Gisa Cecani", section "Shadows over Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana snaps Jace out of the cryptoliths' influence.
timeline.quote: bringing Jace back to his senses by stating that she didn't wish to hurt him anymore

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana raises a zombie army against the Eldrazi Horrors.
timeline.quote: she began to raise a zombie army to fight the Eldrazi Horrors overrunning the plane

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Shadows Over Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana joins the Gatewatch after the Battle of Thraben.
timeline.quote: she decided to join the Gatewatch , albeit to direct them for her plans

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Shadows Over Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin recruits Olivia against Nahiri; she requires that he kill Avacyn, and they raise a vampire army.
timeline.quote: Sorin and Olivia assembled a vampire army and went to war against Nahiri.

citation.text: "Olivia Voldaren", section "Shadows over Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri defeats Sorin and encases him in stone; Olivia proclaims herself lord of Innistrad and takes his sword.
timeline.quote: Olivia proclaimed herself the new lord of Innistrad and took his sword from him.

citation.text: "Olivia Voldaren", section "Shadows over Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn has finally returned to Innistrad, but new evils have come with her and madness plagues the inhabitants.
timeline.quote: Avacyn has finally returned, but what new evils have come with her?

citation.text: "Shadows over Innistrad", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The forces that had protected the humans have been twisted into something dark and strange.
timeline.quote: the forces that had protected the humans have been twisted into something dark and strange

citation.text: "Shadows over Innistrad", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace Beleren of the Gatewatch investigates Innistrad's dark mysteries.
timeline.quote: Jace Beleren of the Gatewatch investigates its dark mysteries.

citation.text: "Shadows over Innistrad", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin searches for the whereabouts of Nahiri.
timeline.quote: Meanwhile, Sorin is in search of the whereabouts of Nahiri

citation.text: "Shadows over Innistrad", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn, affected by madness, turns against humans; Thalia leaves the corrupted church and founds the Order of Saint Traft.
timeline.quote: Thalia left and created the Order of Saint Traft to battle evil

citation.text: "Thalia", section "Order of Saint Traft". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rem Karolus gifts Thalia the spear of the deceased Avacyn.
timeline.quote: Rem Karolus gifted her with the spear of the deceased Avacyn.

citation.text: "Thalia", section "Order of Saint Traft". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Emrakul's presence forces Saint Traft out of Thalia, nearly driving her mad.
timeline.quote: forced Saint Traft to leave Thalia's body

citation.text: "Thalia", section "Order of Saint Traft". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Krallenhorde survives the Cursemute intact.
timeline.quote: The Krallenhorde survived the Cursemute intact.

citation.text: "Werewolf", section "The Krallenhorde". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Innistrad's worldsoul acts hostile to Nissa Revane.
timeline.quote: Innistrad's worldsoul acted hostile to Nissa Revane.

citation.text: "Worldsoul", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Sorin, still weakened from creating Avacyn, is pulled from his restoration by the arrival of another planeswalker.
timeline.quote: Something had pulled him prematurely from his restoration.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Sorin finds the lithomancer Nahiri beside the Helvault.
timeline.quote: Sorin knew her immediately.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nahiri says the Eldrazi broke free of their bonds and she resealed their prison alone.
timeline.quote: With all the strength I could muster, I managed to reseal the titans' prison.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Sorin explains the Helvault is half of what he created to protect Innistrad, perhaps blocking her signal.
timeline.quote: This Helvault is half of what I created to serve as such protection.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nahiri accuses Sorin of abandoning her and breaking their agreement; Sorin dismisses her, recalling that he took her under his wing.
timeline.quote: When your Planeswalker spark first ignited, it was I who discovered you.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nahiri raises a field of floating stones, forges a sword from stone and demands Sorin return with her to Zendikar.
timeline.quote: You will return with me to Zendikar.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Avacyn tears through the clouds and crashes into Nahiri to protect Innistrad.
timeline.quote: the archangel who came barreling into her with enough force to carry both figures off the stone column.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nahiri overpowers Avacyn with her sword, driving her back.
timeline.quote: Soon, Avacyn was in retreat.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Sorin blocks Nahiri's sword, disarms her and holds a blade to her throat, ending the fight.
timeline.quote: Sorin brought the point of his blade up to her throat.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo says she is here only to understand and chronicle, and expects the plane to be doomed.
timeline.quote: I am not here to fix this world's problem. I am here to understand it.

citation.text: "Stories and Endings" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo warns of consequences and says the plane has lost its protector as the world shakes.
timeline.quote: The plane has lost its protector

citation.text: "I Am Avacyn" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2016.

timeline.summary: On another world Arlinn lives as a werewolf with a human mind and learns that she must trust herself to be whole.
timeline.quote: She had to trust herself to be whole.

citation.text: "The Archmage of Goldnight" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri arrives on a bluff on Innistrad and finds the Helvault instead of Sorin.
timeline.quote: On the highest part of the bluff, where she had sensed his presence, stood instead a massive, rough-hewn chunk of silver

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin appears behind Nahiri and she greets him joyfully.
timeline.quote: My friend!" she managed to say at last. "You're alive!

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri tells Sorin she resealed the Eldrazi prison alone after neither he nor Ugin answered her signal.
timeline.quote: With all the strength I could muster, I managed to reseal the titans' prison.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin reveals the Helvault may have blocked Nahiri's signal and shows no concern.
timeline.quote: This Helvault is half of what I created to serve as such a protection.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Early in their acquaintance, Sorin broke Nahiri's arm in a lesson and told her she was no longer mortal.
timeline.quote: You broke my arm!

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri accuses Sorin of abandoning her and breaking their agreement.
timeline.quote: You risked my plane, and more.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin tells Nahiri he owes her nothing and that he molded her, telling her to bother Ugin instead.
timeline.quote: I took you under my wing, and molded you into what you are

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri calls up a granite column and swirling stone darts, declaring she is not going anywhere.
timeline.quote: She called forth a column of rock from the depths beneath them

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri's stone column swallows Sorin and he breaks free in a burst of light.
timeline.quote: but the stone column simply swallowed him.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin binds Nahiri with a beam of moonlight, and she realizes the moon is made of silver like the Helvault.
timeline.quote: It was made of silver. Like the Helvault.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri sinks into the earth to escape the light and reconsider.
timeline.quote: She dug her hands into the soil, extending her will not out, but down, and dove into the earth itself.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri forges a sword from stone and demands Sorin return with her to Zendikar.
timeline.quote: You will return with me to Zendikar.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: An angel crashes out of the sky and slams into Nahiri.
timeline.quote: Then everything went bright again, brighter than the moon, and a shape came screaming out of the heavens.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin stops Nahiri's sword with his own and explains the angel is the other half.
timeline.quote: The other half,

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin disarms Nahiri, puts his sword to her throat, then hurls her into the Helvault, which absorbs her.
timeline.quote: Then the Helvault claimed her, and she vanished into a darkness vast and total.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: A year ago, Nahiri lands in a cobblestone street in Thraben amid chaos as the angel rises in white light.
timeline.quote: Nahiri slammed into a surface on her hands and knees, her endless fall over at last.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri finds her body wounded and mortal-like, no longer an extension of her will.
timeline.quote: Her body was no longer an extension of her sense of self.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri swears that as Zendikar has bled, so will Innistrad, and as she has wept, so will Sorin.
timeline.quote: As Zendikar has bled, so will Innistrad.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Innistrad's final ward falls and the plane is left naked and vulnerable.
timeline.quote: Innistrad's final ward had fallen.

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri calls to the sky for Emrakul to come to Innistrad as the plane trembles.
timeline.quote: Come to me. Come to Innistrad!

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Maeli, guarded by cathars, remembers fleeing his burning village as his mother ordered.
timeline.quote: He had run into the forest like his mother had told him, and he had not gone back to the village.

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Ms. Sadie's chest bursts open into many arms at dinner and she chases Maeli.
timeline.quote: the same writhing arms that had burst out of Ms. Sadie's chest that very night while they ate their dinner

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: The cathars slice off Ms. Sadie's grasping arms.
timeline.quote: The cathars shifted in the tall grass, slicing off one arm after another.

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Maeli prays to Avacyn, who is dead, for help.
timeline.quote: PLEASE, AVACYN! HELP ME!

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: A mad angel announces that Emrakul is rising and dives at Maeli.
timeline.quote: She dove down, her blade slicing through the air ahead of her.

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Bruna and Gisela are gone, becoming one fused angel that proclaims Emrakul.
timeline.quote: Emrakul's angel parted four wings, reached out with two arms, and cried with a single voice that sprang from two mouths

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Emrakul's angel leads the faithful below in a chorus of We are Emrakul.
timeline.quote: Emrakul's angel led all below in following Her radiant form.

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace, shielding his mind with Tamiyo's teaching, is distracted by the warped angel overhead.
timeline.quote: This time it had been the sight of the warped angel in the sky overhead that had distracted Jace.

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace recalls Gideon told him to return to Zendikar if he heard of a titan.
timeline.quote: Gideon himself had told Jace to come back to Zendikar if he heard news of the titan.

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace sees Emrakul for the first time, bigger than the others, with all of Innistrad following her.
timeline.quote: It was the first time he had actually seen Her: the titan, Emrakul.

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace asks Emrakul her name and is flooded with words of conquest.
timeline.quote: The beginning—I shall be all.

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace resolves to bring the Gatewatch to Innistrad.
timeline.quote: It was time to bring the Gatewatch to Innistrad.

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo refuses to come with Jace, saying that is not her path.
timeline.quote: No, Jace. That's not my path.

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo shields Jace's mind so that he can planeswalk away.
timeline.quote: I will protect your mind so you can planeswalk

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri planeswalks away from Innistrad, leaving Sorin trapped.
timeline.quote: Nahiri planeswalked away from Innistrad, leaving Sorin to the fate of his world.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace arrives on Innistrad, finds the sky tearing apart, and stands on a hill above burning Thraben.
timeline.quote: He could see the city now, and half of it was ablaze.

citation.text: "Battle of Thraben" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace overloads the minds of three mad werewolves; two die and the third mutates into something unrecognizable.
timeline.quote: Whatever he had done had triggered some sort of reflexive mutation.

citation.text: "Battle of Thraben" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon arrives and slays the mutated creature as it corners Jace.
timeline.quote: "It's fine, Jace. I've got your back."

citation.text: "Battle of Thraben" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Nissa arrive, and Jace lays out the plan: Nissa taps the leylines with her glyph, Gideon clears a path, and Chandra channels the energy.
timeline.quote: Nissa will use her planar glyph to tap into the leyline network.

citation.text: "Battle of Thraben" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa warns the plan will fail because the leylines have been redirected into the cryptolith network at Thraben, and after listening she agrees she can do it.
timeline.quote: "It's not going to work. The leylines have already been redirected. Into that."

citation.text: "Battle of Thraben" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri called Emrakul across the Blind Eternities and she arrived on Innistrad.
timeline.quote: At Nahiri's call, Emrakul traversed the vast emptiness between the planes and arrived on Innistrad.

citation.text: Coax from the Blind Eternities (Eldritch Moon, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Corrupted angels collapsed to form the Flight of Nightmares.
timeline.quote: The remnants of Innistrad's corrupted angelic hosts collapsed to form the Flight of Nightmares.

citation.text: Subjugator Angel (Eldritch Moon, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Flights of Goldnight and Alabaster side with Avacyn against humanity, while the Flight of Herons sides with humanity.
timeline.quote: They were the only flight to side with humanity against Avacyn, avoiding corruption.

citation.text: "Angel", section "The Flight of Herons". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin kills Avacyn and Emrakul enters Innistrad, corrupting the remaining angels into the Flight of Nightmares led by Brisela.
timeline.quote: After Avacyn's death at the hands of her creator Sorin , Emrakul successfully entered Innistrad

citation.text: "Angel", section "The Flight of Nightmares". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Her faithful build a memorial to Avacyn from wood, straw, twine and clay.
timeline.quote: her faithful constructed a memorial for her

citation.text: "Avacyn", section "The Unmaking of Avacyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sigarda resists Emrakul's influence and defends humanity, giving rise to the Sigardian Sect.
timeline.quote: Sigarda and the remnants of her Flight were of the few angels who never succumbed to Emrakul's influence

citation.text: "Church of Avacyn", section "The Sigardian Sect". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: When Nahiri draws Emrakul to Innistrad, most of her spawn stay on Zendikar and Emrakul corrupts native Innistrad creatures into mutated spawn.
timeline.quote: When Emrakul was drawn to Innistrad by Nahiri, most of her spawns were left on Zendikar.

citation.text: "Eldrazi/Lineages", section "Emrakul's Lineage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With Avacyn dead, Innistrad's last protections fade.
timeline.quote: With the death of Avacyn , the last protections over Innistrad have faded.

citation.text: "Eldritch Moon", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri summons Emrakul to Innistrad to take revenge on Sorin Markov.
timeline.quote: Nahiri has summoned Emrakul to the plane, to take revenge on Sorin Markov .

citation.text: "Eldritch Moon", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Emrakul twists plants, animals and sentient beings into Eldrazi Horrors.
timeline.quote: twists all things living, be it plants, animals, or sentient beings, into Eldrazi Horrors

citation.text: "Eldritch Moon", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace brings the Gatewatch and Liliana brings hordes of undead as unlikely allies to save Innistrad.
timeline.quote: Jace Beleren brings the Gatewatch , and Liliana Vess brings hordes of undead immune to Emrakul's influence.

citation.text: "Eldritch Moon", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Emrakul's arrival on Innistrad turns local fungi into threats such as the Moldgraf Scavenger.
timeline.quote: entities like the Moldgraf Scavenger formed from the local fungi, threatening humans

citation.text: "Fungus", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Battle of Thraben, Liliana helps the Gatewatch; Gideon is trapped in an illusion with Erebos, freed by Jace, while Emrakul is sealed in the moon.
timeline.quote: Gideon was trapped in a scene where he was confronted again by Erebos

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "Battle of Thraben". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Jace decide to offer Liliana the place in the Gatewatch that Tamiyo declined.
timeline.quote: Jace and Gideon talked and decided to offer Liliana the place instead

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "Battle of Thraben". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin destroys Avacyn and Emrakul arrives.
timeline.quote: Sorin Markov showed up and destroyed his creation.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Unmaking of Avacyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace, Nissa and Tamiyo trap Emrakul in Innistrad's moon.
timeline.quote: Jace combined forces with Nissa and Tamiyo to trap Emrakul in Innistrad's moon

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Battle of Thraben". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo reveals that Emrakul overtook her and wanted to be sealed.
